items.title: Is Lumentum (LITE) Quietly Redefining Its Moat With This Post-Retirement Quality Guru Arrangement?
items.summary: In late July 2026, Lumentum Holdings Inc. disclosed that long-serving Executive Vice President of Global Reliability & Quality Vincent Retort plans to retire in October 2026, then remain with the company for two years as a consultant while his existing equity awards continue to vest as long as he provides services. This transition keeps deep reliability and quality expertise inside Lumentum at a time when customers are increasingly focused on secure, high-performance optical components for...

items.title: New report warns China transceiver ban would hurt U.S. AI giants
items.summary: Investing.com - Chinese optical module makers control roughly two-thirds of global transceiver supply, and no Western alternative can absorb that volume within the next one to two years, Counterpoint Research warned — a finding that casts doubt on whether a proposed U.S. import ban can be executed without damaging the AI infrastructure buildout it is meant to protect.
